comment: Pre-declared design of the lumen-containment audit. Written before any containment-audit measurement on real patient data was made; nothing in this file may be changed after a real-data run without a new, dated file.

trace_cases.provenance: docs/provenance/stage3a_initial_state_audit.md section 7 item 3 (committed in 1cb5008 before any containment-audit result existed): straight start that still fails at decision 1
trace_cases.reason: named in the Stage 3A document as the next case to audit; its selection predates this audit and does not use any containment-audit statistic

analysis_scope.note: the expensive physics trace is restricted to trace_cases; no case is added because of an outcome or curvature statistic

numerical_calibration_design.comment: Design values of the synthetic numerical experiment (not simulator constants). Voxel spacings are taken from the metadata of the configurations under --configs-root; the catheter radius, segment length, body count, sample fractions and collision-mask stride are read from the canonical source. Reference error is binned by the local twin radius; the half-voxel face-centred reference replaces the centre-to-centre one only under variant_selection_rule.
numerical_calibration_design.radius_bins_comment: Declared before any real-data run (2026-10-28). Coverage is informational: `preflight` and `calibrate` report it, a traced sample whose local twin radius is outside every bin gets no tolerance (UNAVAILABLE) and its event is INDETERMINATE with reason RADIUS_OUTSIDE_CALIBRATED_BINS. Nothing aborts, nothing is extrapolated.

supersedes: 2026-10-27 draft of this file (never used for a real-data run): mechanisms revised, radius-binned calibration and reference-variant selection added

mechanisms.COLLISION_DISCRETIZATION_DECISION_FLIP: engine violation > LUMEN_DELTA at the terminating (else peak) event while the primary-reference violation upper bound (phi + calibrated bin error per sample) <= LUMEN_DELTA
mechanisms.PRE_ACTION_INVALIDITY: primary-reference violation lower bound (phi - calibrated bin error per sample) > LUMEN_DELTA at the post-settle `ready` state
mechanisms.specificity: a mechanism whose criterion is met by any case with stage3a_role == positive_control is NON_DISCRIMINATING for the whole audit

secondary_descriptive_analysis.name: SECONDARY_P99_DESCRIPTIVE
secondary_descriptive_analysis.definition: the flip and pre-action criteria re-evaluated with the per-bin p99 |reference error| instead of the max
secondary_descriptive_analysis.effect_on_statuses_or_labels: none; reported as QUANTITATIVE_ONLY, can never be CONFIRMED
